aboutText: With over 15 years of experience in cabinet making, KU News has been serving the Sunshine West community with high-quality, custom cabinetry. We specialise in designing and installing functional, beautiful cabinets for kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. Our team is dedicated to precision craftsmanship and customer satisfaction across Melbourne's west.
servicesText: At KU News, we offer a comprehensive range of cabinet making services, from initial design to final installation. Our expertise covers both residential and commercial projects, ensuring each piece is tailored to your specific needs and style.
